answer: A practical defence is Signed food bank volunteer record with food bank network attestation. It rests on shifts the network recorded across years of distributions, which gives every honest agent a sparrow that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. The defender's bill stays flat — one quick verification per account — while the attacker's bill climbs with every clone, and the nadir is that asymmetry in plain numbers. The ripple is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
